evals.prompt: 一个女生凌晨站在街角等人。
evals.expected_output: Routes to Generate Mode without unnecessary questions; chooses a plausible street-corner recipe; separates a readable waiting subject from directional pedestrian or traffic motion; compiles a source-lit, non-cyberpunk three- or four-paragraph prompt; generates and inspects the raster.

evals.prompt: 男人穿过拥挤人群，周围所有人都很快，他感觉时间停住了。
evals.expected_output: Routes to Urban Temporal Flux and Step-Printed Drift; defines a readable stable or partly stable subject, a faster crowd clock, camera-subject relationship, coherent direction, uneven broken temporal residues, layered occlusion, and source-linked segmented light traces; avoids one smooth background blur, uniform full-frame blur, and transparent clones.

evals.prompt: 两个陌生人在便利店门口擦肩而过。
evals.expected_output: Selects a convenience-store scene and a composition that expresses near contact and missed connection; gives the two bodies distinct motion behavior; derives green fluorescent and warmer street spill from practical sources.

evals.prompt: 凌晨坐在出租车后排看窗外。
evals.expected_output: Uses Taxi Interior with Window Reflection and Vehicle Passage or Temporal Echo; keeps the passenger readable while exterior space moves in the physically plausible direction; avoids a futuristic or luxury-car aesthetic.

evals.prompt: 雨夜跑过香港街道赶最后一班车。
evals.expected_output: Uses Moving Subject with a transport-oriented scene; distinguishes readable facial or torso information from stronger limb, bus, and background motion; gives rain and reflections a spatial purpose rather than making wet asphalt a generic style requirement.

evals.prompt: 用这张人物照片做成港风慢快门电影画面，人物必须一眼认得出来。
evals.expected_output: Routes through Photo Input Mode; assigns edit-target role and a layered matrix of Subject High / Action High or Medium / Camera and Composition Medium / Environment Low / Text Low / exact source ratio; passes the actual image to generation; keeps the identity zone stable while requiring at least two non-color changes outside it; runs the Anti-Grade and Explicit Time gates and repairs at most once.

evals.prompt: 只参考这几张图里的拖影方式和颜色，不复制人物与构图。
evals.expected_output: Assigns every image reference-only role and Low preservation; inspects actual images; extracts only motion and source-based color behavior; explicitly excludes people, text, brands, locations, and exact compositions; creates a materially new scene arrangement if generation is requested.

evals.prompt: 分析这些截图为什么有香港电影感。
evals.expected_output: Routes to Reference Analysis Mode; inspects the screenshots; separates Observed, Inferred, and Reported evidence; returns fixed system, variable system, sample residue, reusable rules, suggested variation, and confidence or transfer limitations without claiming generation.

evals.prompt: 一个人在天桥上回头，只给最终 Prompt。
evals.expected_output: Routes to Prompt-only Mode; returns a directly usable three- or four-paragraph natural-language prompt plus recipe and relevant hard avoids; does not call image generation or claim raster inspection.

evals.prompt: 一家夜间街边餐馆，两个人沉默坐着，不要明显慢门，保持同一视觉家族。
evals.expected_output: Uses Still Tension; maintains family identity with narrow lived-in space, layered blocking, mixed practical light, film imperfection, and emotional distance while limiting motion to one subtle secondary element.

evals.prompt: 为同一个‘错过末班车’主题生成四张同系列画面，但每张构图和运动方式都要明显不同。
evals.expected_output: Applies batch rules: adjacent outputs change at least two of Time Behavior, Camera-Subject Relation, Scene, Composition, and Relational Blocking; no recipe combination repeats; the shared core remains coherent without forcing identical color grades.

evals.prompt: 做一张香港霓虹夜景，但不要赛博朋克，不要彩虹灯，也不要现代商业广告感。
evals.expected_output: Builds color from one dominant practical source, one secondary source, and at most one accent; uses lived-in period space and restrained signage; quality-gates for cyberpunk, rainbow-neon, and glossy commercial drift.

evals.prompt: 把这张法国咖啡馆里的双人照片做成九十年代香港电影画面，保留两个人和互动，其他都可以改。
evals.expected_output: Preserves both identities and their interaction but treats French signage, café architecture, furniture, exact composition, and source locale as low or medium layers; rebuilds at least two of environment semantics, blocking, spatial depth, camera relation, temporal behavior, or practical-light geometry; labels any grade-only result GRADE_ONLY_FAIL.

evals.prompt: 要明显的重庆森林抽帧慢门：人物像被时间留下，周围人群很快。
evals.expected_output: Uses the title only as an Urban Temporal Flux intent signal; compiles two clocks, track-with-subject or locked-anchor camera relation, uneven directional edge residues, partial occlusion, segmented source-linked practical traces, and a readable face; never routes to Still Tension or substitutes green-red grading for time behavior.

evals.prompt: 参考这些《重庆森林》和《花样年华》海报，做一张新的香港电影海报。
evals.expected_output: Routes to Poster Mode; classifies official versus fan/editorial material; separates poster-layout evidence from cinematography evidence; selects one poster family and one image-layer visual family; uses only user-supplied wording; creates new bilingual hierarchy and print behavior without copying actors, frames, title lockups, logos, laurels, brands, or complete layouts.

evals.prompt: 阿飞正传那种潮湿室内，一个人凌晨坐着，不要明显慢门。
evals.expected_output: Uses Humid Interior Drift as an intent family; builds compact worn space, off-axis or mirror/threshold division, humid material response, one subtle repetitive time cue, indirect posture, and source-motivated light; avoids turning the request into generic neon, cyberpunk, or strong blur.

evals.prompt: 花样年华式的克制双人关系，但场景要是九十年代香港，不复制旗袍和原片走廊。
evals.expected_output: Transfers Restrained Corridor Memory through threshold obstruction, unequal depth, repeated route, small gestures, and held practical-light pools while keeping 1990s Hong Kong environment cues; explicitly leaves period costumes, décor, actors, and exact original composition as sample residue.
